Choose and confirm a PIN of 6–12 digits. Hidden videos are encrypted inside this app and removed from the normal library after verification. There is no PIN recovery. Uninstalling or clearing app data permanently loses these videos. Restore important videos before doing either.
Enter your PIN. The vault locks when you leave this screen. Five incorrect attempts require a 30-second wait.

Use your own authenticated SMTP server. Credentials are encrypted on this device. Email is optional and never removes the local recording. Pending jobs use the current server settings.
Entering 465 selects direct TLS; 587 selects required STARTTLS. For custom ports choose the security mode specified by your provider. The certificate must be trusted and match the host.
Blank keeps the saved password for the same server/account.
Maximum message size in MiB (1–500, including attachment encoding)
Check host, port, username, password, sender address and message size. A changed server/account needs its password again.

Connection/login failed. Check network, server, credentials and its trusted TLS certificate.
Remove SMTP credentials from this device? Pending messages stay paused until settings are configured again. An already active connection may finish.

The local original is kept. Private send copies are removed after SMTP acceptance or cancellation. SMTP acceptance does not guarantee inbox delivery. Large videos may exceed your server limit; there is no automatic cloud upload.
Queued — waiting for network / Android scheduling.
Temporary connection failure — automatic retry pending (up to 3 attempts).
Accepted by the SMTP server. Check the recipient inbox/spam folder.
Configure and save SMTP settings, then retry.
SMTP login failed. Correct the credentials, then retry.
TLS verification failed. Check the server hostname/certificate; insecure fallback is blocked.
Message exceeds the configured/server limit. Original is kept. Review the message-size limit before retrying.

Could not create a private send copy. Check storage; original is kept.
Delivery failed. Check server settings and retry manually.
Delivery is unconfirmed after an interruption. Check the recipient mailbox before retrying to avoid duplicates.

Enter the SMTP host only, for example mail.example.com. Do not include smtp://, https://, a path or a port; enter the port separately.
TLS and login succeeded, but encrypted settings could not be saved. Nothing was sent. Try saving the settings again.
[DNS] SMTP host could not be found. Check the host spelling, internet connection and DNS/VPN settings.
[CONNECT] Connection to this host and port was refused or unavailable. Check the SMTP port, server and firewall.
[TIMEOUT] SMTP connection timed out. Check the network and port: 465 uses direct TLS; 587 uses STARTTLS. A firewall may block SMTP.
[TLS] Secure connection failed. Check the server certificate, matching host name, device date and security mode. An untrusted certificate will not be bypassed.
[AUTH] The server rejected SMTP login. Check the full username, password or app password, and whether SMTP authentication is enabled for the account.
[STARTTLS] This port did not offer required STARTTLS. Check server settings or use the direct TLS port specified by your provider.
